name: 90731 · San Pedro, CA
findings: ZIP 90731 (San Pedro) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90731 (San Pedro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90731 (San Pedro) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
